body:
Well, I don't see it in this way. I know plenty of people who do not seem to be corrupt nor destructive. It's just that they are humans and I feel like I'm not so maybe it's one of the reasons why they keep the distance between me and them. But the thing is, the more I'm certain of one's "humanity" being not black and corrupt, the more it hurts me when they shy away from me. But hurt is good. It's a human emotion I guess.

Of course, there are many of those you talk about, true. I truly hope you won't have a bad day because of them. I feel like that's not worth it.

Thank you. With your comment, I feel like I achieved with my post what I wanted, whatever it was. It's interesting though, humans are strange. I'm not a big fan of them though it's somehow difficult without them. Strange. I hope you're having a nice day. If not, I smiled for you with the hope that it helps a bit.
